statements.source: "CREATE VIEW dead_letter_reconciliation AS WITH RECURSIVE roots(root_item_id,root_job_id,item_type) AS (SELECT i.item_id,i.job_id,i.item_type FROM job_items i WHERE i.state='dead_letter' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_replay_items r WHERE r.replay_item_id=i.item_id)),lineage(root_item_id,item_id,depth) AS (SELECT root_item_id,root_item_id,0 FROM roots UNION ALL SELECT l.root_item_id,r.replay_item_id,l.depth+1 FROM lineage l JOIN job_replay_items r ON r.source_item_id=l.item_id WHERE l.depth<64) SELECT roots.root_item_id,roots.root_job_id,roots.item_type,CASE WHEN sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state IN('processed','skipped') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 THEN 'resolved' WHEN sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state IN('queued','running','cancel_requested') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 THEN 'in-progress' ELSE 'actionable' END AS reconciliation_state,sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS replay_count,sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state IN('processed','skipped') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved_descendants,sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state IN('queued','running','cancel_requested') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_descendants,sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state='dead_letter' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_descendants,max(items.updated_at) AS last_updated_at FROM roots JOIN lineage ON lineage.root_item_id=roots.root_item_id JOIN job_items items ON items.item_id=lineage.item_id GROUP BY roots.root_item_id,roots.root_job_id,roots.item_type"

schema.name: dead_letter_reconciliation
schema.sql: CREATE VIEW dead_letter_reconciliation AS WITH RECURSIVE roots(root_item_id,root_job_id,item_type) AS (SELECT i.item_id,i.job_id,i.item_type FROM job_items i WHERE i.state='dead_letter' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_replay_items r WHERE r.replay_item_id=i.item_id)),lineage(root_item_id,item_id,depth) AS (SELECT root_item_id,root_item_id,0 FROM roots UNION ALL SELECT l.root_item_id,r.replay_item_id,l.depth+1 FROM lineage l JOIN job_replay_items r ON r.source_item_id=l.item_id WHERE l.depth<64) SELECT roots.root_item_id,roots.root_job_id,roots.item_type,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM maintenance_task_items m JOIN maintenance_tasks t ON t.task_id=m.task_id WHERE m.item_id=roots.root_item_id AND t.state='resolved') OR sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state IN('processed','skipped') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 THEN 'resolved' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM maintenance_task_items m JOIN maintenance_task_items n ON n.task_id=m.task_id JOIN job_items j ON j.item_id=n.item_id WHERE m.item_id=roots.root_item_id AND j.state IN('queued','running','cancel_requested')) OR sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state IN('queued','running','cancel_requested') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 THEN 'in-progress' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM maintenance_task_items m JOIN maintenance_task_waivers v ON v.task_id=m.task_id WHERE m.item_id=roots.root_item_id AND v.state='active') THEN 'waived' ELSE 'actionable' END AS reconciliation_state,sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS replay_count,sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state IN('processed','skipped') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved_descendants,sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state IN('queued','running','cancel_requested') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_descendants,sum(CASE WHEN lineage.depth>0 AND items.state='dead_letter' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_descendants,max(items.updated_at) AS last_updated_at FROM roots JOIN lineage ON lineage.root_item_id=roots.root_item_id JOIN job_items items ON items.item_id=lineage.item_id GROUP BY roots.root_item_id,roots.root_job_id,roots.item_type
